# GloryStarPack

GloryStarPack is a Xiamen-based cosmetic packaging manufacturer, custom cosmetic packaging supplier and OEM/ODM packaging partner for beauty brands, contract fillers and packaging distributors.

## Core Offering

- Glass cosmetic packaging: cream jars, serum dropper bottles, essential oil bottles, roll-on bottles, perfume bottles, lotion bottles, ampoules, vials and diffuser bottles.
- Plastic cosmetic packaging: airless pump bottles, lotion bottles, PET bottles, HDPE bottles, jars, tubes, foam bottles, deodorant sticks, makeup packaging, travel sets, PCR and refill plastic packaging.
- Pumps, closures and accessories: fine mist sprayers, lotion pumps, treatment pumps, foam pumps, disc caps, flip caps, screw caps, droppers, rollerballs, liners, spatulas, applicators and color matching sample rings.
- Bamboo and wood packaging: bamboo bottles, jars, caps, dropper bottles, roll-on bottles and makeup packaging.
- Aluminum packaging: aluminum bottles, soda-can and beer-can style aluminum can containers, tins, tubes, jars, atomizers, sachets and refill pouches.
- Eco packaging: biodegradable PLA, kraft paper tubes, paper boxes, wheat straw packaging, molded pulp packaging and refill packaging.
- Home fragrance and spa packaging: candle jars, wax melt tins, reed diffuser bottles, room spray bottles, car diffusers, essential oil sets, bath salt jars, body scrub jars, hotel amenity mini bottles and travel toiletry kits.
- OEM/ODM service: custom molds, logo printing, hot stamping, UV printing, silk screen printing, frosting, color coating, electroplating, laser engraving, Pantone color matching, custom retail boxes, molded inserts, QC and export packing.
- Private label support: stock packaging selection, custom logo decoration, sample proofing, matched bottle and jar sets, pumps, caps, applicators, retail boxes, export packing and repeat-order specification control.
- One-stop project support: skincare starter kits, serum dropper sets, makeup packaging kits, nail care packaging sets, travel discovery kits, refill packaging systems and full OEM project kits.
- Core buying-intent keywords: cosmetic packaging manufacturer, custom cosmetic packaging, private label cosmetic packaging, skincare packaging manufacturer, one-stop cosmetic packaging service, cosmetic packaging kits, cosmetic pumps and closures, glass cosmetic bottles, serum dropper bottles, airless pump bottles, cosmetic jars, cosmetic tubes, makeup packaging, home fragrance packaging, candle jar packaging, reed diffuser bottles, hotel amenity packaging, cosmetic packaging MOQ and OEM cosmetic packaging.

## Useful Facts

- Location: Xiamen, Fujian, China.
- Factory scale: 20,000 sqm facility.
- Experience: 15+ years.
- Markets served: worldwide.
- Business type: cosmetic packaging manufacturer, custom cosmetic packaging supplier and OEM/ODM packaging partner.
- Core buyers: beauty brands, private label brands, contract fillers, cosmetic packaging distributors, skincare brands, fragrance brands and makeup brands.
- Typical stock sample time: 7-10 working days.
- Typical custom sample time: 15-20 working days.
- Typical bulk production time: 25-35 working days after sample approval.
- MOQ guidance: many glass and eco products start from 300-500 pcs; plastic packaging commonly starts from 1,000 pcs.
- Quote request essentials: product type, capacity, material, closure, decoration method, order quantity, destination country, timeline, formula notes and reference photos or drawings.
